neighbours.label: the token ' story' / ' Story' (narrative sense), strongest where it heads a compound (story time, story books, story structure, storytelling); other narrative nouns and 'two-story' stay quieter
fire: Every Thursday the librarian leads story time for toddlers.
The shelf by her bed is full of story books from her aunt.
The workshop covers plot, character and story structure in one afternoon.
Before bed the children begged for one more story hour.
The editor asked the reporters to pitch three story ideas by noon.
A strong story arc keeps viewers watching for a whole season.
The game designers hired a writer to build its story world.
Each chapter ends with a set of story prompts for the class.
